item.title: Ilia Malinin makes Olympic history with backflip
item.description: Ilia Malinin etched his name in Olympic history by executing the first legal backflip in 50 years during the Milan Winter Olympics 2026, securing gold for Team USA in figure skating. The 21-year-old's daring move captivated a packed audience, including tennis star Novak Djokovic, and marked a pivotal moment since Surya Bonaly's penalized attempt in 1998. Malinin's performance, scoring 200.03, edged out Japan's Shun Soto, ensuring Team USA's victory in the team event.
